矢.memory: An arrow marker starts with a short diagonal, crosses two rails and opens into two feet.
矢.visual: Show a golden straight practice arrow and its stand as one compact front-facing shape. Short diagonal at upper left, short upper rail, longer middle rail, two diagonals splaying below. Small boy points beside it. Soft toy appearance.

刀.memory: One curved blade drops below a squared upper grip.
刀.visual: A stylized wooden stage sword in a blocky top-and-right hook silhouette, with one long broad curved blade sweeping down-left inside the hook. Boy looks at it upright on a tiny display stand, clean simple shape.

弓.memory: A bow bends from a boxed top to a hooked foot.
弓.visual: One brightly colored wooden display bow shown upright, shaped as a boxy stepped ribbon: top runs right and bends downward, midline goes left and folds right again, lower leg curves inward. The boy looks at the shape from outside; keep any string very fine.

汽.memory: Water droplets meet a large curl of rising vapor.
汽.visual: Three droplets down the left. On right small diagonal and two short horizontal wisps sit above a thick steam trail that extends across then down and curls up at far right. Boy holds a tiny warm cup beside it.

第.memory: Bamboo tabs mark steps arranged in order.
第.visual: Two bamboo tip groups on top. Below a looped three-tier wooden stair with a bold central upright and a separate lower-left diagonal support. Boy points to one step; no digits or labels.

宮.memory: One roof covers two chambers, one below the other.
宮.visual: A broad gold-red roof spans the top with one small top nub. Stack one small square chamber above one larger square chamber, joined by a short diagonal doorway. Boy explores the lower doorway.

整.memory: A bundle and its brace sit straight on a measured base.
整.visual: Top left a square wood bundle on a stem with splayed feet. Top right a short angled cap over two clearly crossed braces. Below both, a broad rail above two short uprights on a flat base. Boy straightens the upper bundle.

昭.memory: The sun shines beside a lamp whose square face calls out light.
昭.visual: Two blocks side by side. Left a large warm divided square sun. Right a short hook-shaped golden lamp cap over a square light opening. Boy admires the lamp from its lower right.

級.memory: Thread runs onto a taller, stepped hook.
級.visual: Left a neatly folded skein with three loose ends. Right a short upper diagonal, strong horizontal cap and curled support with a sweeping crossed lower branch. Boy passes one thread upward along the grades.

詩.visual: Left three stacked speech bars over one square speaking opening. Right put an earth-shaped platform above a hooked measuring post with one offset dot, styled as a little temple. Boy recites beside the opening. No marks that read as text.

丁.memory: A straight street meets a long hooked side street.
丁.visual: One long straight horizontal street with exactly one descending road attached near the middle. It runs down nearly straight and curls left at its foot. Show map in top view. Tiny boy walks beside the lower curl.

豆.memory: Beans fill a square dish on a wide stand.
豆.visual: One short flat lid above a big square bean compartment. Two small angled supports sit beneath the compartment on a strong broad level base. Boy sets a bean in the compartment.

暑.memory: The midday sun blazes over a person bent above a hot tile.
暑.visual: A divided square sun at top. Below, a broad diagonal passes across two short rails over a square window with a stripe inside. The mascot fans himself outside the sunlit window.

帳.memory: A sheet sits beside long unfolding pages.
帳.visual: Left hangs a narrow cloth with a raised center seam. At right a tall stack of short horizontal notebook folds ends in two long legs, one diagonally sweeping right. Boy opens the lower page. No text in the notebook.

羊.memory: A sheep has two horns above three fleece bars.
羊.visual: Two small curved horns incline inward above a boxy fluffy face. Three horizontal fleece bands meet one thin vertical stem that extends below the bottom band. Boy pats the sheep on one side.

笛.memory: Bamboo sits above a flute box with an upright air pipe.
笛.visual: Two separate bamboo accents on top. Under them one square gold instrument has four sections and one tall central pipe that projects above the rim. Boy listens from the side; keep the pipe visible.

氏.memory: A family crest curves into a low hooked root.
氏.visual: One narrow cap slants at top over a vertical left post, crossed by a single long middle rail. A broad separate diagonal stems from the upper center and curves right at its foot. Boy stands by a tiny plain family ribbon.

結.memory: A thread ties a little good luck sign.
結.visual: Left folded red thread with three loose ends. Right put a little cross with a second horizontal base over one square opening. Boy ties one strand around the sign after threading it through.

案.memory: Someone under a roof plans at a wooden table.
案.visual: Stack a roof with small top dot, a woman with crossed legs and one outstretched arm, and a large 木-shaped desk with broad boughs and splayed feet. Boy points to a blank plan on the desk.

挙.memory: A hand rises under a tray with three raised accents.
挙.visual: Three small strokes across the top lead down to a broad horizontal shelf with two splayed supports. A single hand reaching up dominates below with its wrist following a straight centerline and two horizontal finger groups. Boy lifts it from one side.

松.memory: A pine stands beside an open pair of slopes and a curled cone.
松.visual: Left a bold 木-shaped pine with wide branches. Right two separate small slanting marks spread outward above one angular curled pinecone shape. Boy finds a small cone near its base.

票.memory: A ballot slips from a paneled box onto a stand.
票.visual: Stack a wide top rail with a shallow divided box right below, then a marker made of two rails with center leg and two splayed feet. Boy slides a blank paper into a narrow slot.

器.memory: Four square containers surround a little figure in the middle.
器.visual: Place exactly two square containers across the top and two across the bottom. A small friendly dog with spread legs occupies the middle gap. Keep all four squares readable; boy stands outside one corner.

士.memory: A tall upright figure stands firm on a short foot.
士.visual: A broad horizontal shoulder rail crosses one central upright; a visibly shorter horizontal rail grounds the upright at its foot. Style the structure as a traditional armor stand with a tiny round crest. Boy bows beside it.

健.memory: A person walks beside a board with a stack of bars.
健.visual: Small standing boy forms far-left upright. Right, one tall staff passes through a stack of five short pegs; a wide curved track wraps from the left of the staff under it and sweeps right. An energetic training scene.

隊.memory: A line walks beside a hill and a splayed group marker.
隊.visual: Left tall narrow green ridge with two ledges. Right two short slanted accents crest one horizontal marker above three curved sweeping ribbons. Boy and two tiny teammates line up along its low edge.

標.memory: A standing pine holds a tall sign made of a grid over rails.
標.visual: A broad 木 tree stands left. At right a shallow rectangular grid hangs over a marker made of two rails and three little legs with a longer center leg. Boy follows the sign; use only colored shapes on it.

司.memory: A hooked booth frames an opening that gives directions.
司.visual: A long top rail turns down into a big right hook enclosing a short bar above a square speaker opening. Tiny boy points from that opening; keep clear space on its left.

康.memory: Grain fans out under a shelter and a centered sieve.
康.visual: Broad top and left roof with small cap. Inside a short upright crosses three short horizontal shelves, then opens into a clear fan of three grain paths below. Boy rests beside it.

紀.memory: Thread follows a curled keepsake ribbon.
紀.visual: Left the folded red skein with three ends. Right one golden squared zigzag curls up at the bottom. A small boy threads blank memory tags on the lower curve. No writing.

博.memory: A cross stands beside a large measured study board.
博.visual: At left one bold cross. Right put a boxed, divided study board crossed by a stem that sticks up, with a small upper-right dot. Directly beneath the board a hooked ruler crosses a rail with a little lower-left marker. Boy studies beside it.

救.memory: Water scatters as two crossed supports help lift it.
救.visual: Put a central short hooked staff through a horizontal rail at left, with distinct water marks spreading alongside. On right an angled cap over two crossed diagonal lifting supports. Boy helps pull a tiny toy float to safety.

功.memory: A strong lever gets work done beside a work stand.
功.visual: Left a top and bottom rail linked by one short upright like a spool stand. Right one big curved lever with a hooked foot and a slanting brace down-left. Boy lifts a little load.

養.memory: A sheep feeds from a bowl beneath its own crest.
養.visual: At top two horns and short crossed fleece rails. Below place a broad peaked cover above one boxy food tray and two sweeping lower feet. Boy feeds a tiny lamb near the tray while keeping the stacked contour visible.

街.memory: Two walking tracks frame stacked earth markers.
街.visual: At left two slanting stepping boards on an upright. In center stack two short earth crosses. At right a long straight hooked signpost and a top bar. Boy walks along the open passage between the two sides.

節.memory: Bamboo shows its joints above a hinged fitting.
節.visual: Two grouped bamboo tips across the top. Beneath those at left a narrow two-bar box with a lower diagonal, and at right a squared hook with long vertical leg. Boy opens a little hinge at the joint.

郡.memory: The ruler's sign stands by the county gate.
郡.visual: On left a long bent cap passes through two horizontal rails above one square speaking opening. On right a narrow gate marker, with a round hook and long descending post. Boy checks the county boundary near it.

典.memory: A divided book rests on two feet like a display stand.
典.visual: At top one large wide shallow book with two vertical dividers that extend over the top and a single horizontal crossing. Below it one wide rail and two distinct diagonal feet. Boy studies an open page with no text.

倉.memory: A peaked roof shelters a divided door over a box.
倉.visual: Stack a broad sloping cap, a short angled mark and upper panel with two inside lines, then one bold square room below. Boy carries a parcel into the lower room.

唱.memory: A square mouth sings beside two stacked sun tiles.
唱.visual: On the left a bold square mouth. On the right two square yellow sun-lamps are stacked vertically, one smaller, each bisected by a horizontal line. Boy sings beside the mouth; small glints with no music notes.

旗.memory: A flag flutters beside a wide barred rack.
旗.visual: At left an upright flag and sloping curved support with small angled top accents. At right a panel of short rails crosses two uprights above a flat base and two slanted feet. Boy holds the flag near its base.

梅.memory: A plum tree stands beside a fruit basket with two marked fruits.
梅.visual: Left one large plum tree with a bold woody cross silhouette. Right an angled cap over a tilted basket crossed by a strong horizontal rail, with two plum dots inside. Boy reaches for one plum below the rail.

牧.memory: A cattle marker stands beside crossed herding rails.
牧.visual: At left a gently horned wooden cow silhouette built around one tall upright and two horizontal rails. Right small angled cap and two splayed crossing rails. Boy guides a tiny calf by gesturing beside the right rail.

泣.memory: Three tears fall beside a standing figure.
泣.visual: Exactly three large blue tears down the left. On the right a short cap with dot and one horizontal rail above two partly slanted supports on a long foot. Boy cries beside the base. The frame stays larger than him.

径.memory: Footsteps lead to earth beneath two crossed paths.
径.visual: On left a pair of small slanted steps and a vertical leg. On right two broad paths cross above a firm earth marker made of a short cross and flat base. Boy walks beside the crossing.

脈.memory: A body panel stands beside branching streams.
脈.visual: Left a tall rounded panel with two interior stripes. Right a long cap bends down-left above staggered blue streams fanning from beneath the ledge. Boy checks a small pulse symbol beside the body panel.

鏡.memory: Metal holds a bright mirror on two feet.
鏡.visual: Left a triangular cap over gold bars and tiny ingots. At right a small stand cap sits above a tall reflective square with a single horizontal division and two splayed feet below. Boy finds his tiny reflection inside.

巣.memory: Three chicks perch above a nest in a tree.
巣.visual: Exactly three small chicks form the top row. Below them an upright trunk passes through a four-pane square nest support and opens into crossed boughs and two long roots. Boy looks up from the edge.

芽.memory: Grass grows above a budding stem shaped like a fang.
芽.visual: Two little grass tufts and one horizontal rail at top. Below, a long hooked plant stem crosses a shorter rail and two tapering boughs, left one down-left. Boy crouches beside a tiny green bud on the hook.

腸.memory: A warm body panel sits near long curling tubes.
腸.visual: A tall rounded body panel with two broad pale inner bars at left. At right stack a square sun window over a horizontal stripe and three separated tubes curving down-left. A friendly mascot examines the model from the right.

統.memory: Thread joins together two separate ends under a cap.
統.visual: On the left a bold red skein with three ends. On right a short top dot and rail sit over an angular folded shape atop two outward feet. Boy ties a strand between the left skein and right structure.

保.memory: A person stands guard beside a small raised cubby.
保.visual: Boy forms a tall narrow upright at left. At right a bold square cubby shelters a tiny child; below it a tall stem and crossbar splay into two branches. Keep left figure and right box readable.

基.memory: A broad basket rests on an earth foundation.
基.visual: At top a large wooden rack with two upright pegs crossing three bars and two small legs. Directly below that stands an earth cross with a broad level foot. Boy lays one little foundation stone.

価.memory: A person examines a valuable item inside a paneled frame.
価.visual: At left a narrow upright boy. At right a broad lid over a shallow square divided into upright sections like a cabinet. Boy places a small gem in the center bay.

提.memory: A hand lifts a straight stand beneath the sun.
提.visual: Tall hand wrist with two little side fingers at left. Right split square sun rests directly above a horizontal rail and long leg, then a broad baseline extends to the right. Boy lifts a small offering along that line.

応.memory: A heart responds from under a shelter.
応.visual: A dotted roof and long angled left wall form a shelter open to the right. A vivid red heart and two dots sit inside at the lower center. Boy knocks gently outside and gets a tiny sparkle in reply.

検.memory: A tree is inspected beside a covered checklist stand.
検.visual: Large 木 tree at left. On right a peaked cover sits over a rail and box opening whose lower supports spread like two legs. Boy inspects a branch using a tiny magnifying glass.

証.memory: Spoken words meet a sturdy, straight marker.
証.visual: At left a dot, three stacked speaking bars and one bold square speaker. At right two horizontal rails and a long upright rise above a level foot with a small stepped left support. Boy presents a blank token.

護.memory: Words guard a bird hiding under the grass.
護.visual: On the left stack speech lines above one square opening. At right stack two grass shoots over a bird with three horizontal feathers, over two crossed hand ribbons. Boy gestures protectively at the side.

態.memory: Two hooks and a body panel sit above the heart.
態.visual: Top left put a curled knot above a ribbed body panel. Top right two matched upright hooks sit one above the other. Center a broad red heart and two small separated side dots under both, with boy nearby.

条.memory: A crossing path sits directly above a spreading branch.
条.visual: Above, two narrow paths cross beneath a slanting cap. Below, one upright shelf and two visibly diagonal branches plus a center stem. Boy clips a blank card to one branch.

幹.memory: A sun marker sits beside a tall bare trunk.
幹.visual: At left a square sun with one divider between two short crosses. At right a large peaked canopy above two short horizontal rails through a single tall bare post. Boy measures the trunk from one side.

独.memory: A doglike curve and one lone insect stand apart.
独.visual: Left is a narrow curved animal outline with a short head accent and two crossing limbs. Right one square-backed insect on a central stem ends in a low sweep and tiny dot. Boy quietly observes it.

率.memory: A tied mark and droplets sit above one crossed measuring post.
率.visual: A short gold rail and one small centered dot sit at top. Below the rail, one small folded ribbon sits between four blue oblong counters: exactly two stacked diagonal counters to its left and two to its right. An upright post and one horizontal bar form a simple cross directly below the trio. The boy compares the sides from the lower corner. Keep all four counters at the height of the folded ribbon and leave the center clear.

衛.memory: Two ends of a road guard a gate with splayed steps.
衛.visual: Narrow double step with upright left and long hooked post right. Between them place two shelves over a square opening, lower marker ends split outwards. Boy stands in the passage.

張.memory: A bow stands beside a long unfurled ribbon.
張.visual: At left one upright blocky bow with squared upper kink and curled foot. At right a tall panel with horizontal slats opens at the bottom into two long angled drapes. Boy stretches a tiny ribbon from the longer side.

義.memory: A sheep crest sits above a balancing frame.
義.visual: At top two tilted horns and short fleece bars. Under them a crossing staff with a narrow right curl and one little offset dot. Boy balances two tiny tokens beside the staff. Peaceful classroom scale motif.

評.memory: Spoken words are weighed on a flat stand.
評.visual: Left stack three speech bars and one square mouth. Right two level bars cross one upright with two short angled marks between the bars. Boy compares two equal chips beside the stand.

製.memory: A divided frame forms the top of a clothes-making stand.
製.visual: On top left a rail crosses a narrow hanging cloth and on top right two slim hanging edge strips. Below those draw a broad garment with crossing folds and splayed hems. Boy carries a folded sample.

授.memory: A hand passes something to another under a cover.
授.visual: Left tall upright hand. Right a little upper row of fingers over a wide low cover and two broad lower ribbons crossing. Boy passes a tiny blank baton across.

修.memory: A person practices beside a narrow post and three downward sweeps.
修.visual: Left a standing boy and one short narrow post. Upper right a small cap and two crossed braces. Below the brace draw three parallel small ribbons slanting down-left. Repeated motions cue practice.

織.memory: Thread weaves a bright tile beside a hooked frame.
織.visual: On left a skein with three loose ends. Right a small cap stands over one square tile; long hooked beam crosses just beyond it on the right with one distinct dot. Boy threads the tile into the frame.

故.memory: An old square sign sits beside two crossed supports.
故.visual: Left is one little cross over a square opening. Right a short diagonal and horizontal bar over two crossing ribbons. Boy studies how the old hinge works.

弁.memory: A bent loop controls an opening on two supports.
弁.visual: At top an angular loop with a short tail. Beneath a broad straight rail carries two uprights that reach downward, one diagonal and one straight. Boy turns a tiny toy tap beside the loop.

素.memory: Plain thread hangs under a simple crossed rack.
素.visual: At top three simple horizontal bars crossed by a short center stem. Below a blank white folded skein has three distinct hanging tips. Boy pulls one simple strand from the side.

益.memory: An overflowing dish sits below two small angled pieces.
益.visual: Two short opposing slants top a wide rail. Bend two short supports down toward a broad shallow dish whose four compartments are visible from the front. Boy catches one extra bead spilling over.

興.memory: Two hands lift a box together above two clear feet.
興.visual: At upper left and right two supporting hands wrap around one centered square container with a single internal mark. A broad base runs beneath both and two diagonal feet extend below. Boy helps lift the box from a corner.

志.memory: Strong resolve sits above a warm heart.
志.visual: At top a tall cross and broad shoulder rail stand on a visibly shorter foot. Directly below that a bright red heart with two detached little dots. Boy holds a tiny light beside it.

属.memory: A lidded shelter holds a divided curled-tail toy.
属.visual: A sloping roof crosses the top and drops on the left. Inside at right stack a square divided window over a broad open-bottom frame containing a curled tail. Boy sets one bead into that frame.

災.memory: A stream and a flame warn of trouble.
災.visual: Three upright curved water ribbons line up at top. Beneath them a single isolated stylized flame has two detached sparks and two splayed lower feet. Boy holds a simple warning pennant at the edge. Harmless symbolic illustration.

銭.memory: Metal sits beside two crossing coin ribbons.
銭.visual: On left cap and short gold rails over two small ingots. On right two short horizontal rails intersect one long curved diagonal with a little offset dot. Boy counts two gold coins beside it.

謝.memory: Words reach a standing figure and a measured gesture.
謝.visual: Stack speech bars and a square mouth on left. Right a tall divided body tile leans beside a short hooked post with one crossbar and small dot. Boy bows beside the post. No lettering.

仮.memory: A person uses a temporary crossed support.
仮.visual: An upright boy at left. On right a loose ledge slopes down-left and covers two crossed wooden stands. Keep it visibly assembled from temporary removable beams.

賀.memory: An enthusiastic call sits above a shell reward.
賀.visual: At top left a small hooked lever, at top right a square opening giving three glints. Directly below a tall shell with two stripes and two short splayed feet. Boy presents it to a friend beside the shape.

徳.memory: Steps pass a straight panel resting above a heart.
徳.visual: At left two little slanted steps above a narrow post. Right a cap cross over a shallow framed window and a straight rail above a red heart flanked by two little dots. Boy steps carefully near the heart.

序.memory: A hooked ribbon hangs at the very front of a shelter.
序.visual: One small cap dot above a wide shelter eave with left sweep. Inside place two short angular bends above a hook and thin rail. Boy opens a blank scroll at the entrance.

舎.memory: A peaked roof shelters a little cross and square room.
舎.visual: A broad top peak forms the roof. Directly beneath it one short upright crosses two level rails, over a single bold squared doorway. Boy sets slippers outside the door.

敵.memory: A tall sign faces a crossed practice frame.
敵.visual: At left a short capped roof over a frame with a square opening. At right a bit shorter top twig and rail rest over two crossing supports. The boy starts a friendly game between two objects.

酸.memory: A sour jar stands beside a knot over crossing paths.
酸.visual: Left one capped square jar with a horizontal divider. Right a small bent loop on two slanted feet, above crossed supports that sweep wide. Boy puckers at a tiny sour plum near the jar.

桜.memory: A cherry tree stands beside three petals over a figure.
桜.visual: Left one broad pink cherry tree with trunk and crossed boughs visible. On the right three detached petal marks hover directly above a woman posed with crossing legs and one outstretched arm. Boy catches a petal at the edge.

句.memory: A hooked frame wraps a single square speaking mouth.
句.visual: A long curved upper beam runs over and curls down at right. Inside it on the left one broad square speaking mouth. Boy listens from left. No lettering or speech bubbles.

墓.memory: Twilight settles over an earth marker.
墓.visual: Use four separate tiers, from highest to lowest: two small bright green grass tufts on their own shared horizontal strip, then an orange square sunset lantern with one horizontal dividing line, then two broad low splayed stones, then a simple earth cross on a rounded foot. The highest grass strip must be entirely above the lantern, with a visible gap. Boy sets one flower beside the earth cross.

飼.memory: Food is passed through a hooked feeding stall.
飼.visual: At left a peaked cover and stack of short rails form a food tray with a tapered foot. Right one tall rail bends down at the far right around a smaller square opening and shallow bar. Boy offers a snack to a small animal inside.

恩.memory: A person framed above a heart receives kindness.
恩.visual: In the upper half a thick square frame encloses one simple figure with arms and legs spread. Center a large warm heart and two detached little dots below. Boy sets a tiny gift near the heart.

往.memory: Footsteps lead past a tall post with a single dot.
往.visual: Left a pair of slanting steps and a long narrow upright. Right a tall journey marker with three horizontal rails and a cap dot above. Boy walks along the side of the sign.

肥.memory: A body panel fills out beside a rounded curling pouch.
肥.visual: Left a tall body tile with two inner lines. Right a divided upper square sits in an upright hook that widens and curls up at the foot. Boy touches one full padded part.

俵.memory: A person carries a bundle under a crossed cloth.
俵.visual: Boy narrow and upright at left. Right show three short stacked rails through a central tied knot, with two broad crossed cloth folds fanning out below. Make it a wrapped straw bale.

眼.memory: An eye looks beside a curled shape with a divided upper panel.
眼.visual: At left big elongated eye window with two division lines. On right a stout upright square with two stripes and a long curled leg and splayed diagonal below. Boy peers from its lower edge.

潔.memory: Three drops rinse a stack and its dangling threads.
潔.visual: Three blue drops stay at left. Right at top a tall bundle with three rails and short bent cover tab beside it; below a folded white thread hangs with three separate lower tips. Boy rinses one thread.

舌.memory: A tongue extends from a square mouth below a crossed post.
舌.visual: A short slanted cap and crossbar intersect one upright directly above a bold square mouth. The pink tongue peeks out just inside the square. Boy mimics the mouth from its margin.

派.memory: Water leaves the main stream in several branching routes.
派.visual: Three drops down left. Right is a long angled roof ledge and three narrow blue stream branches fanning under it. Boy stands at the point the branches split.

策.memory: Bamboo overlooks a marked stake with narrowing branches.
策.visual: Two bamboo clusters above a square open-bottom wooden frame. A strong vertical stake crosses a short rail and meets two broad diagonal roots. Boy slides one tiny plain plan token under the frame.

裁.memory: A large hooked work frame shelters a robe.
裁.visual: Show a short cross at upper left and a long angled hooked frame sweeping down from top right, with one small offset dot. Hang a robe below the cross inside the frame, with two splayed hem ribbons. Boy pins one piece of cloth.

展.memory: A shelter frames a long strip that unfolds into two broad hems.
展.visual: A wide top and left shelf open on right. Under it place two rails pierced by two upright tabs, and below that cloth folds sweeping apart down-left and down-right. Boy unfolds the cloth.

視.memory: An altar marker stands beside a tall eye on two feet.
視.visual: Narrow altar stand with a top dot and two strong legs at left. Right set a tall boxy eye with two horizontal lines on two separated splayed feet. Boy peers through the center.

株.memory: One tree stands beside a red stem with two rails.
株.visual: Large 木-shaped tree at far left. Right one short slanted top end and two red horizontal boughs crossing one upright, with broad splayed roots below. Boy points at a red offshoot.

姿.memory: Two marks and a bent gesture sit above a woman’s posture.
姿.visual: Top left two separate short blue marks. Top right a curved cap over two outward legs. Below put one adult woman with clearly crossed legs and a wide arm, maintaining 女 silhouette. Boy watches a dance pose.

閣.memory: A tall gate encloses crossing paths over a square doorway.
閣.visual: Outer straight posts and two upper gate panels hold the full scene. Center two broad crossing paths beneath an angled cap and above a single square window. Boy enters from the foot.

衆.memory: A ribbed canopy shelters people spreading out.
衆.visual: Stack a small diagonal cap over a squat tray whose slim interior slats are visible. Beneath it three tiny people form distinct diagonal paths fanning away. Boy is among the three.

推.memory: A long hand pushes a striped bird along.
推.visual: Left upright wrist with two fingers extending right. Large boxy bird on right, with four horizontal stripes and one upright joining them. Boy pushes a small toy bird just below the larger component.

討.visual: Left speech bars over a square speaking opening. Right a tall golden hooked post crosses a narrow horizontal bar, with a small dot offset to the lower left. Boy gestures calmly next to the post.

憲.memory: A roof holds rules over a divided window and heart.
憲.visual: Top broad roof with central cap. Under it stack a crossed rail and a shallow four-pane window. Below these put one broad heart with little separate marks. Boy considers the heart.

激.memory: Water surges beside a bright flag and crossed braces.
激.visual: Three drops down the left. In middle place a white window topping a curled flag rail. On right narrow angled cap and strong crossed braces. Boy watches an energetic splash inside the middle object.

系.memory: A slanted cap tops a folded ancestral thread.
系.visual: One narrow slanted accent across the top. Below it a broad folded red skein follows two sharp bends and fans into three distinct tips. Boy pins a tiny blank tag to one loose tip.

批.memory: A hand compares two nearly matching curls.
批.visual: Left tall upright hand. On right two equal upright figures lean and curl along the bottom, each on its own foot. Boy compares their profiles with a small pointer.

盟.memory: Sun and moon stand together above one common dish.
盟.visual: At top left a divided square sun, at top right a tall moon panel with two short lines. Beneath both one shallow wide dish on a flat base, with clear vertical dividers. Boy puts a token between the lights.

従.memory: Footsteps follow two marks and a long lower trail.
従.visual: Left one slanted stepping pair on a narrow vertical post. Right two short sloping marks above one cross and slanted foot on a broad trailing path that extends right. Boy follows the path.

拡.memory: A hand opens a loop under a wide roof.
拡.visual: Left one upright hand with two short fingers. On right a roof with cap and long left sweep covers an angular loop that bends outward at the floor. Boy opens it up.

就.memory: A tower stands next to one special hooked marker.
就.visual: Left a cap with small nub tops a square window and three separate downward legs. Right a bent upright crosses a slim rail and curls low with a small top-right dot. Boy takes his place by the marker.

異.memory: A divided field stands above a different rack.
異.visual: Top one square four-pane field. Under it one horizontal rail crosses two pegs above a short base and two outward feet. Boy compares a single differently colored field plot.

厳.memory: Three accents sit above a stern figure under a cliff.
厳.visual: Top row three small distinct marks. Below, a ledge runs across then down the left, with two braced inner supports and two crossed ribbons on lower right. Boy stands very straight beside the braces.

遺.memory: A precious shell sits beside a road that curls underneath.
遺.visual: At upper right put a square pierced by one upright over a rail, then a ridged shell with two feet. From the top left start a small stepping dot and a wide trail curving past the shell and under the composition. Boy leaves a small gift by it.

模.memory: A wooden form stands beside three levels of sunset.
模.visual: Bold tree-shaped wooden stand at left. At right place three distinct stacked tiers: green grass sprouts across the highest tier, directly below them an orange square lamp with one dividing stripe, and directly below the lamp two long spread supports. Green sprouts must be visibly higher than the square lamp and may never sit beneath it. Boy compares a tiny model to the larger form.

宣.memory: A roof shelters a signal between two horizontal rails.
宣.visual: Roof with one cap nut at top, then a square divided lantern between one straight horizontal rail above and one below. Boy points to the announcement lantern, no wording.

盛.memory: A slanted hook holds a stand above a full dish.
盛.visual: At top a long diagonal hooked beam, a short crossing cap and one inner support sweeping down; dot at upper right. Set a broad shallow food tray directly below on a flat foot with clear vertical dividers. Boy adds one piece of food.

皇.memory: A white sun tile sits above the royal stand.
皇.visual: Top a white square window with one middle line and short diagonal cap. Below three gold horizontal rails join one vertical stem to form the royal stand. Boy carries a tiny decorative crown beside it.

臨.memory: A retainer looks down at three boxes on a rack.
臨.visual: Left a tall narrow square panel with one visible eye. Right a short slanted ledge hangs above three bold square boxes in a top single and lower pair. Boy examines the boxes from the narrow gap.

源.memory: Three drops mark the spring under a stone ledge.
源.visual: At far left arrange three blue drops. Right a broad stone ledge sweeps down-left; inside stack a white square spring mouth and a small branching water flow below. Boy takes a little cup from the stream.

創.memory: A storehouse stands beside two upright marking tools.
創.visual: Left stack a peaked lid, partly divided upper panel and square lower doorway. At right two slim upright carving-tool silhouettes stand parallel, taller one with a curved foot. Boy brings a little crafted object from the doorway.

障.memory: A narrow hill blocks a tall rising marker.
障.visual: Left a slim cliff with two short ledges. Right stack a little top sign, square divided sun tile, and one bold crossed post below. Boy points out the block between two components.

筋.memory: Bamboo above a body and a lever shows strength.
筋.visual: Two distinct bamboo tips across the top. Below at left a body panel has two stripes, and below at right a hooked lever with one splayed brace. Boy exercises beside the lower lever.

善.memory: A sheep's rails sit above a cheerful square opening.
善.visual: Top two hornlike accents and three short rails crossed by one stem. Below one separate large square mouth smiles. Boy offers one small good-luck token beside the mouth.

密.memory: A knotted bundle under a roof hides among three peaks.
密.visual: Stack one broad roof with cap, a curled ribbon crossed by one wide diagonal and little side marks, and a green three-peak mountain sharing a base. Boy peeks around the mountain’s edge.

我.memory: A crossed hook stands beside the boy’s own marker.
我.visual: A short angled rail crosses a tall stem that has a tiny hook. Across it one longer rightward diagonal curls up, with a little dot high on the right. Boy points at his reflection in a tiny blank round token at the base.

幕.memory: A curtain hangs below the sunset.
幕.visual: Two leaf tufts sit above a divided setting sun and two outward support beams. Under both hang one bold curtain with three central vertical sections. Boy pulls one lower corner.

染.memory: Dye flows beside a curl into a wood frame.
染.visual: Top left three separate dye drops; top right a broad curled hook with one large diagonal. Below both center a 木-shaped wooden dye rack. Boy dips one little fabric corner.

傷.memory: A person tends a warm bundle beside the sun.
傷.visual: Left a single small upright boy sees a square divided lamp on the right. Place a short tilted cap above the lamp and three curled fabric bands below it. One loose band hangs toward the boy, a gentle care scene.

秘.memory: A grain stalk stands beside a heart wrapped by one slant.
秘.visual: Left a golden grain stem with broad crossing boughs and splayed roots. Right a tilted ribbon runs across a red heart-shaped curl with small offset dots. Boy keeps hands near his mouth beside it.

縮.memory: A folded thread is tightened under the small inn roof.
縮.visual: Left one tall skein and three tails. On right a peaked roof holds a narrow upright and a divided square jar side by side. Boy pulls a small piece of fabric so it crumples into the jar.

射.memory: A tall practice target stands beside a little measuring marker.
射.visual: Left a brightly colored tall body-shaped target tile with two inset bars and one short diagonal tail. At right a long center hook crosses a small rail with a dot offset lower left. Boy points at one paper target marker.

揮.memory: A hand waves beside a covered cart.
揮.visual: Tall expressive hand on left. At right wide cover spans above a square cart with vertical center axle and horizontal dividing rails. The boy waves near the base of the hand.

賃.memory: A standing person and post sit above a shell payment.
賃.visual: At top left a narrow upright person, top right a tilted top cap over two rails crossed by one stem. Below both center a bold shell with inner stripes and two little feet. Boy slips one coin toward the shell.

貴.memory: A gem passes through a frame onto a shell stand.
貴.visual: First a medium square frame pierced by one upright. Then a single long rail, then a tall boxy shell with two lines and two detached feet. One small gem shines beside the rail.

納.memory: A thread fits inside a little box.
納.visual: Left a large neat skein with three loose ends. On right a tall frame open on the bottom holds a figure with two legs slanting apart. Boy tucks one strand into the opening.

樹.memory: A tree stands beside a dish and a measuring hook.
樹.visual: Left a tall 木 tree. In center stack a short cross over a square dish and two little feet with a rail. Right a thin upright hook crosses one rail beside a separate dot. Boy measures the tree.

至.memory: A little folded marker comes down to the ground.
至.visual: Stack a short cap and angular inward curl above a distinctive earth cross resting on a flat broad foot. Boy reaches this landing point from the side.

宗.memory: A simple altar fits under a broad roof.
宗.visual: A broad shelter cap with one top dot directly above two horizontal altar rails with three legs: long straight center, shorter diagonals left and right. Boy sets a tiny flower on a corner.

宙.memory: A roof hangs above a box and its rising stem.
宙.visual: Stack a simple broad roof with central dot over one large four-pane square whose center stem rises past its top. Boy looks into the empty square with his hand raised.

操.memory: A hand works a rack of three boxes on a wooden base.
操.visual: Left a tall upright hand. Right exactly three square compartments in a one-over-two pyramid above a tree-shaped base with an upright and two diagonal feet. Boy works one small side latch.

誕.memory: Words meet the start of a long path.
誕.visual: Left stacked speech lines above a square mouth. Right an angled top beam above a short stepped marker and an orange path that wraps from the left and runs out under its feet. Boy points where the path begins.

訳.memory: Words are measured by a long bending ruler.
訳.visual: Left several speech bars and one bold square opening. Right a short boxy upper ruler attaches to two long angled supports that sweep apart. Boy compares two blank color chips beneath the ruler.

看.memory: A hand shades an eye so it can see.
看.visual: A wide slanted hand with three obvious finger bars sits directly over a bold rectangular eye window with two inner bands. Boy looks from its frame’s lower corner.

奏.memory: A stack of rails and broad hands plays above a stand.
奏.visual: A short angled cap and three rails cross a centered stem and then two broad sloping support arms. Put one separate crossed stand under it with splayed feet. Boy taps one tiny bell beside the structure.

郷.memory: A curled ribbon and meal stand sit by a town gate.
郷.visual: Left one tall folded ribbon with an offset dot. Middle a squared food tray with two lines and a curved foot. Right one long gatepost with a notch. The small boy comes home from the right.

己.memory: A single folded path curls back to itself.
己.visual: One golden stepped scroll starts with a flat top, drops at its right edge, folds back left through a broad middle, then curls up on the right at the foot. Boy watches his tiny reflection just outside.

忠.memory: A centered post sits straight above the heart.
忠.visual: A tall golden post passes through a square opening, projecting above and below. Directly underneath put a single red heart with two small detached dots. Boy stands beside the heart.

沿.memory: Three drops flow alongside a small doorway.
沿.visual: Three clear water drops down the far left. On right two tall bent legs lean toward one another above a single square opening. Boy follows the side of the lower square.

誠.memory: Words meet a firm joined frame.
誠.visual: Left a narrow tower of speech bars and a square speaker. Right a wide cap and slanting left leg frame a short inner hook and a sweeping right diagonal curl with one dot. Boy offers one sincere hand gesture.

俳.memory: A performer stands beside two parallel barred rails.
俳.visual: On left a narrow boy playing a role. On right two prominent vertical rails have three short outward-facing bars each, leaving center open. One small theatrical prop rests outside the bars; no lettering.

聖.memory: An ear hears a voice above the royal stand.
聖.visual: At top left one tall boxy ear with two stripes; right one smaller square mouth. Directly below show three golden horizontal rails linked by a single centered stem. Boy watches respectfully beside the frame.

潮.memory: Three drops meet the rising sun, moon and tide.
潮.visual: At far left three blue drops form a vertical column. To their right put a divided sunrise tile between two small crosses. On far right put a long moon tile with two stripes. Boy looks at one tiny tide line below.

鋼.memory: A metal stand sits beside a rugged framed shape.
鋼.visual: At left a triangular cover over stacked bars and two small ingots. Right an open-bottom case holds two small diagonal accents and a three-prong central steel insert. Boy taps the insert from outside.

縦.memory: Thread hangs down beside a marching step.
縦.visual: Left folded front-view thread with three loose ends. Right a short pair of slanted steps next to a vertical line and a larger stepped route with two high dashes. Boy follows the longer upright element.

仁.memory: A standing person offers kindness by two equal rails.
仁.visual: Boy at left stands as a narrow simple silhouette. At right put two separate horizontal plain golden bars, top slightly shorter. Boy shares a tiny gift from the edge of the lower bar.

穴.memory: A peaked shelter has two angled sides around a hollow.
穴.visual: A wide roof with a top nub and short descending sides rests over two separate rounded sloping rocks, left splayed. Center a clear dark hollow between them. Boy peers into it from outside.

暖.memory: A bright window warms a pair of crossing hands.
暖.visual: Left one golden square divided sun. Right a short upper sweep and three little tips over two horizontal bars and two crossing warm cloth ends. Boy warms hands nearby.

朗.memory: A folded bright panel stands beside the moon.
朗.visual: Left one little angular bright ribbon above a squared divided upper panel with a wide lower hooked foot. Right one long pale moon lantern with two crossbars. Boy enjoys its soft light.

肺.memory: A body's ribbed panel sits beside a divided air cloth.
肺.visual: Left a tall blue body panel with two inner bars. Right one central upright extends above and below a broad rail and through a square hanging panel. Boy watches airflow in the right panel.

熟.memory: A stacked pot and its side loop sit above four warm embers.
熟.visual: One capped square pot with a short hooked post at upper left, one small curved support at upper right. Center exactly four separated glowing orange embers along the bottom. Boy enjoys the ripe fruit at the edge.

陛.memory: A narrow hill stands beside two people above solid earth.
陛.visual: Left tall cliff with two short steps. Right two matching hooked upright figures stand side by side over a broad earth cross on a low foot. Boy climbs the lowest step.

糖.memory: Grains sit beside the sheltered sugar stand.
糖.visual: Left a star of individual white grains arranged around one bold vertical shaft. Right top and left form a sugar shed; inside show three short rails and one large square opening below. Boy collects a sugar crystal.

覧.memory: A watchful panel sits above an eye on two splayed feet.
覧.visual: Upper left a boxy panel with one eye and two short bars; upper right little tilted cap over one wide screen. Center a tall upright eye on two feet below the two top shapes. Boy looks across from one side.

奮.memory: A spreading figure and a perched bird stand over a field.
奮.visual: Two sweeping supports form a broad cover above one upright striped bird. Put a single four-pane field beneath the bird. Boy rushes to the field from the lower corner.

后.memory: A square opening sits beneath a sloping overhang.
后.visual: A broad cap bends down-left, with a short horizontal beam under its right half. Directly below that beam one bold square doorway. Boy offers one flower beside the doorway.

班.memory: Two jade stands frame a slim dividing marker.
班.visual: Left three rails meet one upright. Right another three-rail upright mirrors it. Between them put a tall narrow silver divider. Boy sorts two small groups of tokens at the base.

寸.memory: A crossed hook measures a short offset dot.
寸.visual: One tall golden measuring post crosses a short beam near the top and hooks at the bottom. One offset marker dot sits lower-left. Boy checks the distance between marker and post near the base.

磁.memory: A stone attracts two curls below a small cap.
磁.visual: A sloping ledge over a square boulder at left. Right two angled top tabs meet one broad rail above two small curled ribbon loops side by side. Boy watches the loops pull toward one another.

垂.memory: Several levels hang from one central stem.
垂.visual: A short sloped top blade crowns one long stem. Four shallow horizontal levels intersect it, with the broadest in the middle and two short outer tabs. Boy hangs one bead from the bottom.

穀.memory: A covered grain stalk sits beside a hinged support.
穀.visual: Left a small cross and wide cap shelter a grain stalk with splayed roots. At right two slim curled uprights above two broad crossing golden strips. Boy gathers a tiny grain bundle.

絹.memory: Silk thread comes from a little box over a ribbed panel.
絹.visual: Left pale silk skein folds neatly and has three distinct loose tips. Right square cocoon chamber over a tall pale panel with two bands. Boy draws one strand gently out of the chamber.

尺.memory: A bent ruler opens into a long diagonal foot.
尺.visual: A wide top panel drops into a left slant. From the inside edge a separate long measuring beam sweeps down-right, clearly leaving an open triangle under the panel. Boy measures one short distance.

蚕.memory: A tiny silkworm lives beneath a broad spreading cover.
蚕.visual: At top two strong horizontal rails and two broad legs splayed outward. Beneath them a boxy little silk insect on an upright, with a low curved trail and small offset dot. Boy holds a fine silk thread from the outside.

企.memory: A peaked cover stands above a straight stepped foot.
企.visual: Two diagonal roof halves above a simple stepped mark with one broad horizontal foot and two upright levels. Boy sketches a blank plan to one side; keep the long straight upright visible.

藤.memory: Grass covers a ribbed vine and a fan of drops.
藤.visual: Top two leaf tufts joined by a shallow rail. Below left one tall ribbed body panel. Right two short dashes and crossed rails above a fanning flow of wisteria petals. Boy watches the hanging blossoms.

沢.memory: Three droplets collect near a dropping ruler shape.
沢.visual: Left three distinct water drops. Right a square-edged ledge extends down-left while a long diagonal sweeps right from below its cavity. A small marsh pool rests only beside the diagonal.

援.memory: A tall hand helps brace crossed parts beneath a shelf.
援.visual: A long wrist and short fingers form a left silhouette. Right a row of three short accents above two rails, then two clearly crossed braces below. Boy steadies the right structure from outside.

施.memory: A flag gives shade beside a hooded curled stand.
施.visual: Left a flag post with little top dot and a long sweeping foot. At right a small tilted cover above two slender uprights across a broad hooked bowl. Boy passes one tiny gift beneath the cover.

井.memory: A well is marked by two bars through two uprights.
井.visual: Exactly two horizontal beams cross exactly two upright beams around a small dark central opening. Front view, one outer support a little diagonal at bottom. Boy stands beside the low well.

鮮.memory: A fish and a sheep stand fresh beside each other.
鮮.visual: Left a boxy fish with four-pane body and four little separated fin rays below. Right two inward horns over three fleece rails on one stem. Boy arranges a tiny fresh display at the base.

監.memory: A watchful panel and person stand above a broad shallow tray.
監.visual: Upper left a narrow box containing an eye. Upper right a small slanted cap above a sloping figure and short bar. Below both center one flat shallow tray with upright divisions. Boy checks it.

環.memory: A jade rack sits by a loop with a divided top and split foot.
環.visual: At left three green rails cross a slim upright. Right stack a low four-pane frame, then a short rail over a small square opening, finally two broad cloth ends splaying diagonally. The boy holds one tiny ring beside the lower right.

審.memory: A roof shelters grains above a four-pane field.
審.visual: Stack a broad roof and a short slanted accent over a bold grain star with splayed rays. Directly below set a distinctly square four-pane plot. Boy checks the field with a small magnifier.

訴.memory: Words face a tall angled fixture and an offset mark.
訴.visual: Left dot and speech bars over one square speaking mouth. Right a slanting cap and long downward shaft cross a narrow rail; place one little slash to the right of the shaft. Boy points toward a harmless example.

影.memory: A light over a pavilion throws three parallel shadows.
影.visual: At upper left a square divided sun over a peaked marker, small square window and three feet. At far right three separated dark diagonal ribbons sweep down-left. Boy compares his small shadow from the margin.

撃.memory: A cart and braced stand sit over one broad hand.
撃.visual: Upper left a square cart body with axle. Upper right two short hooked legs above crossed ribbons. Below both show a flat hand with three clear finger bands and long wrist. Boy taps a little toy drum once.

佐.memory: A person helps a work stand under an angled beam.
佐.visual: Left a narrow upright boy. Right a long slant descends from a wide crossbar over a separate squat stand with top, center post and flat foot. The boy helps hold the slanted beam.

核.memory: A tree stands beside a curled shape with a gathered center.
核.visual: Left one large 木 tree. Right stack a dotted cap and short angular fold over several diagonals spreading outward. Boy points to a small fruit core tucked in the center.

融.memory: Warmth beside a boxy insect softens the frame.
融.visual: Left a top rail above a square opening and wider frame with split feet. Right a little boxy insect on a vertical stem with a low curve and small offset dot. Boy watches a soft drip just inside the left frame.

渉.memory: Three drops mark a place where a foot steps across.
渉.visual: Left three separated water drops. Right a short stepped marker and a narrow stem between two dashes over a long diagonal path. Boy steps across beside the low end.

響.memory: A town and its gate send sound to a square tile below.
響.visual: Top row folded ribbon, square meal stand and thin notched gatepost. Beneath them center a small cap on a narrow platform above a strong square sun tile with one horizontal line and two little echo marks outside it.

請.memory: Speech meets a blue sprout growing above a striped panel.
請.visual: Left stack speech bars and a square mouth. Right three short blue rails cross one stem above a rounded blue two-bar tile. Boy raises a small hand by the bottom of the speech opening.

攻.memory: The work stand meets two crossing practice beams.
攻.visual: At left one upright between two horizontal rails. Right short slanted cap and a tiny bar above two bold crossing supports. Boy moves a small puzzle piece toward the stand.

崎.memory: A mountain stands beside a tall hooked ledge and square chamber.
崎.visual: Left three green peaks on one base. Right a short spread figure cap above one long horizontal beam that turns down on the right. A small square cave opening nests inside the hook. Boy stands near its foot.

督.memory: A hand works beside a marker while an eye watches below.
督.visual: Above left short tall marker with two little offsets, above right two crossed hand ribbons. Directly below both one large upright rectangular eye with two inner bars. Boy checks it from the side.

催.memory: A person encourages a bird beneath three small peaks.
催.visual: At left the narrow figure of the boy gestures. Right stack a three-peak mountain on one wide base above a boxy upright bird with four strong feather stripes. Leave a clear gap between boy and mountain-bird.

及.memory: A short top tab and a broad hook reach one crossing hand.
及.visual: A very short diagonal accent at top. From a long cap one band drops down-left and a second extends farther right in one smooth, crossing gesture. Boy reaches for a tiny bead beside the tip.

離.memory: A curling cage stands apart from a striped bird.
離.visual: Left a cap and square shallow cage with a clear crossed part inside, opening into a broad hook below. Right a tall upright bird shows four horizontal feather marks and a straight left edge. Keep both shapes separated.

摘.memory: A tall hand picks a fruit from a layered opening.
摘.visual: At left a tall upright hand. On the right a little capped roof with two clear slants sits over a tall square frame containing a small square fruit opening. Boy picks one fruit from the opening.

郎.memory: A bright divided panel meets a narrow town gate.
郎.visual: On left a short dotted ribbon top over a square panel with two horizontal dividers and a low right sweep. On right a slim upright town gate with a small rounded notch at top. Boy stands beside it.

振.memory: An upright hand shakes the edges of layered ground.
振.visual: Left a tall upright hand with two projecting fingers. Right a ledge runs along the top and down-left over two solid earth rails and two broad splayed ends. Boy sets a little movement marker near the earth.

献.memory: A covered southern stand sits next to a friendly dog.
献.visual: Left a small cross above a square open-bottom tray with uprights and horizontal shelf, right a much simpler spread-legged dog with one small collar dot. Boy brings a small offering from below.

維.memory: A folded thread stretches beside a striped bird.
維.visual: Left a tall narrow folded red thread with three separate ends. Right an upright stylized bird with four clean horizontal feather bands. Boy links a tiny strand between them.

浜.memory: Three water drops meet a two-foot scenery marker.
浜.visual: Three blue drops at far left. Right, a short slanted cap on a tall crossed frame above a straight shelf and two clearly splayed feet. Boy spots a little coastal shell at one foot.

塁.memory: A gridded field is marked by dots and a cross at its base.
塁.visual: One four-pane field at top, a row of four little separated earth markers directly beneath, and a taller bold earth cross on a flat foot at the bottom. Boy reaches the base from one side.

邦.memory: A tall banner stem stands beside a country gate.
邦.visual: Left a short slanted top rail above three horizontal bars crossing one tall stem, which curves slightly at its foot. Right a tall narrow gatepost with two rounded hooks along its right edge. Boy approaches the gate.

遣.memory: A stepped mailbox sends a parcel along a swinging road.
遣.visual: Upper right stack a little crossed window over a horizontal rail and two open square slots on a tall board. Left and bottom, a wide road sweeps around it and out to the right, starting with a separate stepping dot at upper left. Boy sets off beside a parcel.

抗.memory: A tall hand braces a cap balanced above curling legs.
抗.visual: Far left the upright hand silhouette. On right a small dot above a single horizontal beam, then two broad feet underneath, right foot curled. Boy holds the structure steady.

雄.memory: A tucked hook sits beside an upright striped bird.
雄.visual: Left a short cap and diagonal support above an angular curl. Right a tall bird shows four bold horizontal stripes. The boy stands by the bird’s feet; both shapes stay distinct.

緊.memory: A watchful panel and hands hold a skein tight.
緊.visual: Top left tall boxy eye panel and two narrow bars. Top right two crossing hand ribbons. Center beneath both a tied skein with three separate trailing tips. Boy tightens the tie.

廃.memory: A shelter covers a fanning stand that is being put away.
廃.visual: Wide top and left roof with small cap. Inside a short pair of splayed marks sits over two rails crossed by two upright pegs and curled feet. Boy folds the stand from its base.
